pair.loss_reduction: Frozen optimization: mean represented class(mean A group(mean polygon hinge)). Descriptive exposure-weighted means are not the training objective reduction.
pair.interpretation: Increased d_AN relative to d_AB and decreasing Pair/SupCon scalars show a nonzero learned ranking signal, but do not validate segmentation or repaired semantics. No evidence here proves universal embedding collapse or causal performance harm/benefit.

gradient_clipping.definition: Native parameter L2 after AMP unscale and before Clip10; every gradient-bearing parameter contributes, including projection. Formula c=min(1,10/(norm+1e-6)); postclip estimate is norm*c, not a separately measured gradient norm.
gradient_clipping.interpretation: 100percent clipping alone does not establish exploding gradients, Pair domination or an ineffective auxiliary branch. c is not an exact AdamW effective learning-rate multiplier; no clip/LR/lambda change is proposed.
